scripts.setup: set -eu; ROOT="${CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH:-}"; if [ "${CONDUCTOR_IS_LOCAL:-1}" = "1" ]; then export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use; fi; if [ -n "$ROOT" ] && [ -d "$ROOT" ]; then for f in client/.env client/.env.local server/.env scratch-cli-tests/.env.integration; do [ -f "$ROOT/$f" ] && cp "$ROOT/$f" "$f"; done; fi; if [ -n "$ROOT" ] && [ -d "$ROOT/local" ] && [ ! -e local ]; then ln -s "$ROOT/local" local; fi; yarn install; (cd server && yarn prisma generate); (cd packages/shared-types && yarn build)
scripts.run: set -u; export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use >/dev/null; trap 'kill 0' EXIT INT TERM HUP; yarn dev & ( (cd scratch-git-2 && cargo build --bin scratchmd) && (cd scratch-desktop && yarn dev) ) & wait
